summary: Experienced climber Thad Friday (48) fell to his death from third-class terrain while descending the walk-off from the Bastille after rope-soloing the tower.
notes: ANAC 2023 edition (Pub 2023); incident date Mar 3 per article. BCSO release (case 22-883): 300-400 ft fall witnessed; Mountain View Fire paramedics pronounced deceased; RMRG evacuated body to trailhead; death not suspicious.
